sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Amelie. In this podcast,
we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words and ideas many times. Today,
we travel to Europe. We go to France. Our city today is Annacy. Annacy is calm. Annacy
is close to nature and water. Please relax. Please listen slowly.
Let's begin our journey together. Part two. France and Europe. France is a country in Europe.
It is famous all over the world. France has history. France has art. France has food and
culture. Many people visit Paris. Many people visit big cities, but Annacy is different.
Annacy is smaller. Annacy is peaceful and gentle. Part three. Where is Annacy?
Annacy is in the east of France. It is close to the border with Switzerland. The city is near the
place. Annacy is next to a lake. The lake is called Lake Annacy. Water and mountains are everywhere.
The city feels fresh and clean. Part four. Weather and seasons. Annacy has four seasons. In spring,
flowers grow, trees become green. In summer, days are warm. People swim in the lake. In autumn,
leaves change color. The city looks soft and quiet. In winter, it can be cold. The mountains have snow.
Life changes with the seasons. Part five. A city with long history. Annacy is an old city.
People lived here many years ago. The city was important in the past. It was a place of trade and
travel. Old buildings still stand today. Old streets tell old stories. History is part of daily life
in Annacy. Part six. The Old Town. Annacy has a beautiful Old Town. The streets are narrow.
The houses are colorful. Small canals run through the streets. Water flows quietly.
People walk slowly. They stop and look around. The Old Town feels warm and romantic.
Part seven. Canals and water. Annacy is sometimes called the Venice of the Alps.
Small canals are everywhere. Bridges cross the water. Flowers grow near the canals.
Reflections shine in the water. Water is part of daily life. Water brings calm and beauty.
Part eight. Lake Annacy. Lake Annacy is very famous. The water is clean and blue.
People swim in summer. People walk near the lake. Families relax. Friends meet and talk.
The lake gives peace. The lake gives life to the city. Part nine. Daily life in Annacy.
Daily life in Annacy is slow and calm. People wake up early. They work. They study. In the afternoon
people walk. In the evening people rest. Life is balanced. Life is quiet and happy.
Part ten. Food and local life. Food in Annacy is simple and warm. People eat cheese,
bread, and soup. Cheese is very important. Meals are shared with family. People sit together.
They enjoy time and conversation. Food brings people closer. Part eleven. Nature and outdoor life.
Nature is very close to Annacy. Mountains are near. People go hiking. People ride bicycles.
In winter people ski. In summer people swim. Nature is part of everyday life.
Part twelve. Feeling spirit and goodbye. Annacy is a city of water, mountains, history, and calm life.
It is not loud. It is not fast. It is peaceful. It is beautiful. It is full of soul.
